svg.title: C16-M01-F2: Wi-Fi frame types and the deauth threat
svg.desc: The three Wi-Fi frame types and how unprotected management frames enable deauth attacks, defeated by PMF.
svg.text: C16-M01-F2 Wi-Fi frame types and the deauth threat
data frames : the traffic (encrypted under WPA2/WPA3)
management : beacon, probe, auth, ASSOCIATION, DEAUTHENTICATION
unprotected mgmt -> forged DEAUTH knocks clients off (DoS / push to evil twin)
defence: Protected Management Frames (802.11w), required by WPA3
Figure C16-M01-F2. Management frames and why PMF matters [C16-M01-R2].
